summary: This excerpt of Florida Statute 627.351 creates and governs Florida residual-market property insurance mechanisms, including the Florida Property and Casualty Joint Underwriting Association and Citizens Property Insurance Corporation. It specifies Citizens’ governance, eligibility, plan of operation, rates, assessments, account structure, and reporting requirements, including quarterly statistical reports, annual audited financial statements, and policy-data elements prescribed by the office.
